description: Delete a content automation rule by id. Removes the saved rule so it no longer runs on future triggers; returns the deletion result. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_delete_content_automation
title: Delete Content Automation
